data.title: How Much Will One Bitcoin Be Worth in 2030?
data.description: Bitcoin sits far below its record, yet bold forecasts for 2030 keep climbing. Weakening ETF demand, a 2028 halving, and a stalled Senate bill will decide which targets survive, and one popular dream may demand a market value rivaling the money supply.
